description: ADR-0043 decision 3: the text parameters of the built-in tools that write human-readable text outside the platform: every external_send tool, and the write tools that create or change a pull request, an issue, a case, a ticket or a page with a description or body. The categories do not change: a write tool listed here keeps its approval defaults. The worker appends the AI disclosure marker to each listed parameter before the call. A path is a top-level argument (`comment`) or a text field of each object in a top-level list (`inline_comments[].comment_text`). `format` markdown targets render HTML comments as hidden, so the marker carries the run id there; plain targets get the text only. Every external_send tool of tool-categories-v1.json is listed under toolkits or under exempt with a reason. Tools whose text is inside a JSON document argument (Jira create_issue, Bitbucket create_pull_request, Azure DevOps Boards create_work_item) are not listed: the marker would change the document. Read by the Rust worker and by elitea-main (the opt-out toolkit types); elitea-main keeps a copy that a test holds equal.

jira.update_comment_with_file: Adds a file to a comment that exists. The tool writes no text of its own.
